description: Department of Local Government - Southern Province - Notice Under Section 66 C (4) Appointed Chairman and Vice Chairman for Weligama Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically deals with the reconvening of a meeting to elect a Chairman and Vice Chairman for a local authority (Weligama Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It contains election scheduling information, which falls under electoral processes - the core focus of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes). The content involves election procedures and meeting dates for filling elected positions in local government, making it clearly an elections-related matter rather than general government personnel changes or other administrative categories.
